summary: Use the discovery notes to prepare a concise research synthesis for ReadingLight. Explain what we learned and what still needs validation. Preserve the context the next designer will need.

relevance.rationale: Frames the two-room purpose while retaining unknown formal goal-approval status.
Supports the local seating problem and preserves the interview sample size.
Provides the local observational count without an invented rate or intervention effect.
Prevents overgeneralizing the local findings into population demand.
Identifies the untested benefit hypothesis that must remain separate from observed findings.
Preserves the unrepresented populations and the action-specific limit on demand claims.
Defines the accepted prototype scope that research and the next designer must carry forward.
Separates design authority from the unestablished visitor-facing release approval.
